title: This Facebook Ad Format Gets Insane Results (and nobody uses it!)
description: This Facebook Ad Format Gets Insane Results (and nobody uses it!)
transcript: Carousell ads are fantastic for increasing average order value because with Carousell ads you can put multiple offers multiple products in front of people at the ad stage. That makes it more likely that they'll buy multiple things from you post click. An increasing average order value is really important. It can make your Facebook advertising so much easier because if you make $200 instead of $50 from each new customer you get, you can pay a lot more to acquire them in the first place.
